editorial: Prepare yourself for a fever dream where sci-fi tropes collide with low-budget adult fantasies in the most chaotic way possible. You will find a bizarrely ambitious premise that treats a global erotic plague with the gravity of a disaster movie while leaning heavily into camp absurdity. The sheer audacity of the costume design ensures you will never look at space travel the same way again. It is a perfect pick for those who enjoy watching cinematic trains wrecks that refuse to slow down.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of midnight movies and intentional B-movie kitsch.
